title: Starting a Business with a Friend
paragraphs: Deciding to launch a small consulting business with his closest friend seemed like an obviously good decision to Waleed, given their complementary skills and years of established personal trust between them.

Within the first year, however, unexpected friction emerged over decision-making authority, as neither partner had clearly defined who would handle final decisions when their professional opinions genuinely conflicted.

Rather than allowing accumulated resentment to eventually damage both their business and their friendship, they consulted a business mediator who helped them establish clear, written protocols for resolving future disagreements.

Three years later, the business operates successfully with considerably clearer boundaries, and both partners agree that formalizing their working relationship, despite feeling unnecessarily formal between close friends initially, protected something far more valuable than efficiency alone.
